exposure: expectant management of cesarean scar pregnancy
cohort: 10 patients with a previous history of a uterine scar diagnosed with CSP in the first trimester, who refused to terminate their pregnancy and continued with PAS, managed at Latifa Hospital, Dubai, UAE, over a period of four years from 2018 to 2022
finding: Expectant management of CSP in patients who refuse termination of pregnancy and continue with PAS is possible with multidisciplinary care and careful monitoring in a tertiary care center.
mod_finding: The study found that expectant management of cesarean scar pregnancy with placenta accreta spectrum is possible with multidisciplinary care and careful monitoring, with most patients delivering in the third trimester via elective or emergency surgery.
gest_age: First trimester at diagnosis, nine out of ten delivered around 34 weeks gestation
